title: K Empty Slots
summary: You have n bulbs arranged in a sequence numbered from 1 to n.
statement: You have n bulbs arranged in a sequence numbered from 1 to n. Initially, all bulbs are off. Each day, exactly one bulb is turned on until all bulbs are lit after n days. Given an array bulbs indicating the day each bulb is turned on and an integer k, determine the earliest day when two lit bulbs are separated by exactly k unlit bulbs. If no such day exists, return -1.
constraints: bulbs is a permutation of positions 1 through n; 0 <= k <= n-2.
Return the earliest day when two lit bulbs have exactly k unlit positions between them, or -1.
hints: Convert positions to the day each bulb turns on.
A valid position window has both endpoints earlier than every interior day.
Scan windows of width k+2; reset when an interior day is earlier than an endpoint.
If no interior bulb is lit by the later endpoint day, exactly k slots are empty at that time.
editorial: If no interior bulb is lit by the later endpoint day, exactly k slots are empty at that time.

tests.explanation: On day two, positions one and three are lit while position two remains unlit.
No day has one unlit bulb strictly between two lit endpoints.
